page_title: OpenAgents: An Open Platform for Language Agents in the Wild

summary.name: OpenAgents
summary.one_liner: OpenAgents is an open platform, described in an arXiv paper, for using and hosting LLM-based language agents for everyday tasks, including data analysis, API plugins, and web browsing.
use_cases: Analyzing data with Python or SQL through a natural language agent
Calling everyday API tools via a chat-style agent
Autonomous web browsing for research tasks
Hosting language agents locally for development
summary.what_it_does: The paper presents OpenAgents, an open platform for using and hosting language agents built on large language models. It includes three agents: a Data Agent for data analysis with Python/SQL and data tools, a Plugins Agent with 200+ daily API tools, and a Web Agent for autonomous web browsing. A web user interface lets general users interact with these agents, and the platform supports seamless deployment on local setups for developers and researchers. The authors position it as a foundation for building and evaluating real-world language agents.
notable: Three bundled agents: Data Agent, Plugins Agent (200+ API tools), and Web Agent
Web UI aimed at non-expert users, optimized for swift responses and common failures
Supports local deployment for developers and researchers
caveats: The page is an arXiv abstract only; pricing, licensing, and setup details are not stated on the page
